title: Jikji printed with movable metal type
summary: The Jikji was printed in 1377 at Heungdeoksa temple in Cheongju, Korea, using cast movable metal characters. Only its second volume survives, held by the National Library of France, and UNESCO and the international community consider it the oldest known document printed with movable metal type, 78 years before the Gutenberg Bible. Its colophon names the temple and the date.

uncertainty.note: Colophon gives the seventh month of 1377 by an era-year count; month not converted here.
